blocks.html: ROBINSONS LAND CORPORATION’S 17TH OFFICE TOWER CONSTRUCTION ON TRACK

Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), real estate arm of the JG Summit conglomerate, continues to grow its office buildings portfolio with its latest office building in Ortigas Center. The leading property developer recently held its ceremonial concrete pouring for Robinsons Cyberscape Gamma last November 27, 2015.
Cyberscape Gamma is a 37-storey office building development located along Topaz and Ruby roads in the Ortigas Center. It will be connected to the existing Robinsons Cyberscape Beta at the ground and mezzanine floors. Its 45,000 sqm floor area will strengthen RLC’s position as the biggest office landlord in the Ortigas Central Busines District.

The tower will feature two storeys of various retail and dining options as well as service shops to cater to the needs of tenants as well as nearby residents and offices. In the mold of the other office developments of RLC, Cyberscape Gamma will likewise be equipped with high-speed elevators, 100% back-up power, 24/7 Variable Refrigerant Flow AC system for flexibility and control, 24/7 CCTV surveillance, multiple telecom providers as well as an advanced security, fire safety and building management system.

With a large office floor plate, ample basement and podium parking, and a registration with the Philippine Economic Zone Authority on the way, the tower is ideal for offshoring and outsourcing firms as well as corporate headquarters of medium and large corporations.
Robinsons Land Corporation remains bullish on the growing demand for BPO office spaces. It has five other office buildings which are currently being built: Robinsons Galleria Cebu in Maxilom Ave. corner Sergio Osmena Blvd, Cebu City, Robinsons Ilocos in San Nicolas, Ilocos Norte and Robinsons Place Naga located at Diversion road corner Almeda Highway, Naga City; Exxa Tower in Bridgetowne locatedalong C5, Libis, Quezon City and Cyber Sigma located along Lawton Avenue, Bonifacio South, Taguig.

At present, Robinsons Land Corporations has 11 completed office buildings. Recently completed and fully leased projects include Cyberscape Alpha and Cyberscape Beta in Ortigas and Tera Tower in Bridgetowne, Quezon City.
